# Word Search Games Inc.

> Find hidden words, connect letters and follow the clues. Explore word games made for a few quiet minutes or one more puzzle.

Word Search Games Inc. publishes the mobile games below. Each game page has gameplay details, official screenshots, verified store links and store facts checked 21 October 2026.

## Games

- [Word Search](https://wordsearchgamesinc.com/games/word-search/): Word Search is a free word search puzzle game for iPhone and iPad, published by Word Search Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 19 March 2018. A browser version is also available to play online. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/word-search/id1357802596
- [Word Hunt](https://wordsearchgamesinc.com/games/word-hunt/): Word Hunt is a free swipe-to-find word puzzle game for iPhone, iPad and Android, published by Word Search Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 14 March 2018. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/word-hunt/id1357352041, https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=word.hunt.connect
- [Word Hunt Connect: Brain Game](https://wordsearchgamesinc.com/games/word-hunt-connect/): Word Hunt Connect: Brain Game is a free crossword-style word connect game for iPhone and iPad, published by Word Search Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 6 October 2022. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/word-hunt-connect-brain-game/id1642045964
- [Vocab: Learn English Words](https://wordsearchgamesinc.com/games/vocab/): Vocab: Learn English Words is a free English vocabulary app with daily words, flashcards and quizzes for iPhone and iPad, published by Word Search Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 18 December 2024. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vocab-learn-english-words/id6737245144
- [Crossword](https://wordsearchgamesinc.com/games/crossword/): Crossword is a free crossword puzzle game for iPhone and iPad, published by Word Search Games Inc. It was first released on the App Store on 20 July 2019. Download: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/crossword/id1470131814

## Play in your browser

- [Word Search online](https://wordsearchgamesinc.com/wordsearch/): Free browser version, no download required.

## Guides

- [Word search tips: how to find hidden words faster](https://wordsearchgamesinc.com/guides/word-search-tips/): Practical word search strategies: scan for rare letters, check all eight directions, use word shapes and endings, and work through the grid systematically.
